card.name: Comma after a timing clause, before next step
card.fires_on: The comma that closes an opening time or condition clause such as "After at least 10 days following the initiation of X" or "If this rate is tolerated". It sits just before the instruction for what to do next, such as resume or increase.

modes.label: Resume after waiting period
modes.description: Comma after a clause giving days or weeks since starting a drug, before an instruction to resume another drug.
modes.example: After at least one week following initiation of GENVOYA<<,>> resume tadalafil at 20 mg

modes.label: Step-up after time or tolerance
modes.description: Comma after a clause about further weeks or a tolerated rate, before an instruction to raise the dose or rate.
modes.example: After 2 to 4 additional weeks<<,>> the dose may be increased to a maximum

card.writes: It favors words like "once" and "introduced", so the text after the comma is framed as a step that follows the opening condition.
card.plain: It marks the comma after a "after X days" or "if tolerated" clause, just before the next dosing step.
